name: @sauce/zk
description: SauceScript's ZK-coprocessor requests: a question now, and the `.then` body run on the same Private Pot when the proven answer is called back, as a promise of @sauce/async's. `Zk.sql(query)` asks Space and Time a SQL query, proven with Proof of SQL, paying in SXT; its promise is parked under the query's id and expires at the query's timeout, when `Zk.cancel(e)` in its `.catch` takes the payment back; `Zk.cell`/`Zk.rows` read the result's table. `Zk.risc0(request)` asks Boundless's market (Base) to prove a RISC Zero guest ran on an input, the Pot the request's client: its promise is keyed by the guest's image and the sha256 of its stdin, which the journal commits first. `queryCallback` and `handleProof` are the bodies of the handlers the Pot answers Space and Time's and Boundless's callbacks with; Boundless's ERC-1271 check is answered by @sauce/async's one handler, for the request hashes the Pot approved. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (zk.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the coprocessors' contracts are EVM contracts.
